name: scenario_0596
description: Ashlee is working on an FPGA project in Vivado and encountering some SSH connection issues in VS Code. She wants to validate her local project configuration, document the setup, and clean up some temporary test files on her desktop.

simple_note.notes.title: Vivado Legacy Setup
simple_note.notes.content:
Legacy Vivado 2017 installation instructions:
1. Download installer from Xilinx archive
2. Run xsetup as administrator
3. Select Vivado HL WebPACK
4. Accept license agreements
5. Choose installation directory: C:\Xilinx
